music: Bright friendly upbeat pop bed, 120 bpm, no vocals
lines: Welcome to ReStyles. The first AI graphic designer in a box. Here's the whole thing in ninety seconds.
Remake: drop in a design you own, say what to change in plain words, and a minute later it's back. Nothing else moved.
Fix a detail: open any piece from your library, say what's wrong, and only that changes. Every version is saved.
Sizes: pick a design and get every size at once. Print, social, event. Small formats keep the headline.
Slide decks: say what it's about, drop in the look to copy, and every slide comes back in that look, with your numbers exact.
PowerPoint: drop in a deck, say what to change, and download a real, still editable file.
Your library holds everything. Your account shows the balance and what things cost, with deposits from twenty dollars.
One design in. Anything out. That's ReStyles.
